name: 01_dashboard
title: Admin Dashboard
narrate: Vehicle Selector Pro. The merchant dashboard shows catalog coverage at a glance — 7 mapped products, 100 percent vehicle coverage, 29 YMMTE configurations, and zero items needing review.

name: 02_vehicles
title: Vehicle Library
narrate: The vehicle library is the normalized cache behind every storefront dropdown. 33 vehicles across BMW, Chevrolet, Ford, and Jeep — each with Year, Make, Model, Trim, and Engine data, mapped parts, and drivetrain info.

name: 03_fitment_rules
title: Fitment Rules Matrix
narrate: Merchants manage fitment rules in the admin. Every product-to-vehicle mapping is a row in the matrix — with sync status, fitment type, and notes. Rules ship live. Incomplete data stays flagged for review.

name: 05_settings
title: Widget Configuration
narrate: Merchants customize the storefront widget — header title, brand color, subtitle, button labels, and cascading selector depth. Toggle trim and engine selectors independently. Configure My Garage customer features.

name: 06_bulk_imports
title: Bulk CSV Import
narrate: Import thousands of vehicle-to-product compatibility mappings at once. Upload a CSV file or paste raw CSV text. Download the template to get started.

name: 09_github_features
title: Open Source on GitHub
narrate: Vehicle Selector Pro is open source under the MIT license. Built with Ruby on Rails 7.1, PostgreSQL, Sidekiq, and deployed on Fly.io. HMAC-SHA256 verified on every request. Production ready.
